prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic casual close-up selfie portrait using an approved-adult face reference.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with warm natural skin, brown eyes, calm slightly melancholic expression, natural pink lips with berry tint, minimal no-makeup makeup, and a short dark-brown choppy bob with asymmetrical bangs and fine airy strands.
prompt.composition_elements: Half-body chest-to-head portrait, slightly low tilted selfie angle, direct eye contact, face and textured short hair as primary focus, warm simple indoor background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm soft indoor light with realistic glass-skin highlights but visible pores, casual unfiltered smartphone mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic close-up smartphone portrait, natural skin and hair detail, slight lens softness, realistic color and no over-smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyper-realistic close-up portrait of an approved adult woman with warm natural skin, brown eyes, a calm slightly melancholic expression, natural pink lips with a berry tint, and minimal no-makeup makeup. Her short dark-brown hair sits above the shoulders in an uneven choppy bob with soft layers, asymmetrical long bangs, fine strands across the eyes and cheeks, and airy irregular ends. Frame her chest to head from a slightly low tilted selfie angle with direct eye contact, warm soft indoor light, visible realistic skin texture, natural hair movement, subtle lens softness, and a casual unfiltered smartphone feel.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized expression, nudity, altered face, identity drift, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult face reference. Preserve face, facial structure, hair cut, bangs, identity, expression, and natural texture; identity is replaceable only with another approved adult reference. No typography or logo is required.
